questions.subject: english
questions.question: Modern civilization is primarily the worship of ..........
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi kehte hain ki aadhunik sabhyata mukhya roop se bhautikta (material) aur aish-o-aaram ki pooja hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our forefathers did not invent machinery because ..........

options.A: these would have made us lazy and slaves
options.B: these would have made us smart
options.C: these would have made us proud
options.D: these would have made us intelligent

questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj jante the ki yadi hum machino ke peechhe bhagenge to hum aalasi ban jayenge aur unke gulam ho jayenge.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Observing all this, our ancestors dissuaded us from luxuries and pleasures' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh pankti Mahatma Gandhi ke nibandh 'Indian Civilization and Culture' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... were the rulers of ancient Egypt.
questions.explanation: Pracheen Misr (Egypt) ke shashakon ko Pharaohs kaha jata tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Pharaohs ruled over ancient ..........
questions.explanation: Pharaohs pracheen Misr (Egypt) par shashan karte the jinki shakti samay ke sath nasht ho gayi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Simple living and high thinking' is the foundation of ..........
questions.explanation: 'Sada jeevan aur uchha vichar' (Simple living and high thinking) Bhartiya sabhyata ka mool aadhar hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The moral values of .......... are glittering and intact even today.
questions.explanation: Duniya ki anya pracheen sabhyataon ke vinash ke bawajood Bhartiya sabhyata ki neev aaj bhi chamak rahi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Plain living and high thinking' is the motto of a celebrated ..........
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji batate hain ki 'Plain living and high thinking' ek prasiddh Western philosopher ka niyam/motto raha hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Gandhiji warned that for India to run after the Golden Fleece is to court certain ..........
questions.explanation: Bhartiya drishtikon chhodkar bhautikta ke peechhe bhagna Bharat ke liye nishchit vinash ya maut bulana hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the essay, Mahatma Gandhi explicitly clarifies: 'I am no hater of the ..........'
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji spasht karte hain ki weh pashchim (West) se nafrat nahi karte, balki uski achhi baatein sikhne ke samarthak hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our civilization, our culture, and our .......... depend not upon multiplying our wants.
questions.explanation: Hamari sabhyata aur hamara Swaraj ichhaon ko badhane par nahi, balki un par aatm-niyantran rakhne par nirbhar karta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Sacrifice was the sole aim and ideal of our ancient ..........
questions.explanation: Hamare rishiyon aur muniyon ka mukhya dhyey tyaag (sacrifice) aur aatm-shuddhi tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'My Experiments with Truth' was written by ..........
questions.explanation: 'My Experiments with Truth' Mahatma Gandhi ki vishva-prasiddh aatmkatha (autobiography) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi was more of a .......... leader than a conventional politician.
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ek rajneeta ki tulna mein ek mahan aadhyatmik neta (spiritual leader) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is affectionately revered as the Father of the Nation in India?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi ko rashtra ke prati unke amulya yogdan ke kaaran Rashtrapita kaha jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The greatest glory of Indian civilization is that it remains ..........
questions.explanation: Bhartiya sabhyata ka sabse bada gaurav yeh hai ki anya sabhyataon ke mitne ke baad bhi yeh atal (immovable) bani rahi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Wealth and worldly luxuries do not necessarily make a .......... happy.
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji samjhate hain ki dhan aur vilasita akele insaan (man) ko sachha sukh nahi de sakte.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The people of Europe learn their lessons from the writings of the men of ..........
questions.explanation: Europe ke log Greece aur Rome ke pracheen lekhakon ki rachnaon se sabak lene ki koshish karte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the closest synonym of the word 'Glory' in the context of the chapter?
questions.explanation: 'Glory' ka arth mahan gaurav, saundarya ya vaibhav (splendour/beauty) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... was dead against the blind imitation of Western civilization.
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi pashchimi sabhyata ki andhadhundh nakal ke sakht khilaf the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'After all, there is something in Hinduism that has kept it alive up till now' is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti Mahatma Gandhi ke nibandh 'Indian Civilization and Culture' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our ancestors were satisfied with living in ..........
questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj bade shahron ke shor-sharabe aur apradh se door chhote gaon mein shanti se rehne mein santusht the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Civilization is that mode of conduct which points out to man the path of duty' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Sabhyata ki yeh sundar paribhasha Mahatma Gandhi ne 'Indian Civilization and Culture' mein di hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Some of the immediate and brilliant results of modern inventions are too maddening to resist' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Aadhunik aavishkaron ke aakarshan par chetavni dete huye Gandhi ji ne yeh baat kahi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What type of prose piece is 'Indian Civilization and Culture'?
questions.explanation: 'Indian Civilization and Culture' ek preranadayak aur vicharotpadak nibandh (essay) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who wrote the famous monumental book 'The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire'?
questions.explanation: Roman samrajya ke patan par prasiddh pustak Edward Gibbon ne likhi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the expression 'to hunt the Golden Fleece' mean?

options.A: To seek something difficult or impossible to attain

questions.explanation: Yunani kathaon ke anusaar 'Golden Fleece' ka taatparya aisi cheez pane ki koshish se hai jo lagbhag asambhav ya behad mushkil ho.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Attic civilization historically belongs to ancient ..........
questions.explanation: Attic sabhyata ka sambandh pracheen Greece (Athens) ke kshetr se hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Gandhi ji, civilization is that mode of conduct which points out to man the path of ..........
questions.explanation: Sabhyata manushya ko kartavya (duty) aur naitikta ke marg par chalna sikhati hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Hinduism has made marvellous discoveries in things of religion, of the spirit, and of the ..........
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji batate hain ki Hindu dharam ne aatma (soul), aadhyaatm aur dharamik chetna ke kshetr mein adbhut aavishkar kiye hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the closest synonym of the phrase 'Moral fibre'?
questions.explanation: 'Moral fibre' ka arth manushya ka charitra aur uski naitik dridhata (Character) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our ancestors lived independently and enjoyed true .......... rule.
questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj apne gaon mein swatantra rehkar sachhe Swaraj yaani 'Home Rule' ka anand lete the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The Western charge against Indian people is actually an attack against our ..........
questions.explanation: Pashchimi aalochak kehte hain ki Bhartiya log asabhya hain aur badlav nahi chahte, par Gandhi ji ise hamari kshamta aur naitikta (merit) par arop maante hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: With which of the following journals was Mahatma Gandhi actively associated as an editor?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi ne 'Young India' patrika ke madhyam se apne vichar aur lekh desh ke samne rakhe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Indian civilization fosters and worships ..........
questions.explanation: Bhartiya sabhyata bhautik vastuon ke sthan par naitikta (morality) aur sacharitrata ko mahatva deti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the Gujarati equivalent for civilization literally mean?
questions.explanation: Gujarati bhasha mein sabhyata ka arth 'achha aacharan' yaani 'Good conduct' hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the words of Gandhiji, the human mind is a ..........
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji kehte hain ki man ek bechain pakshi (restless bird) hai jo jitna pata hai utna hi aur chahta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What tendency does modern Western civilization propagate?
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ke anusaar pashchimi sabhyata bhautikta aur anaitikta (immorality) ko badhava deti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our ancestors saw that kings and their swords were inferior to the sword of ..........
questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj mante the ki rajaon ki talwar naitikta aur aachar-shastra (ethics) ki talwar ke aage tuchh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: After all, there is something in Hinduism that has kept it .......... till now.
questions.explanation: Duniya ki mahan sabhyataon ke vinash ke bawajood Hinduism ki aadhyaatmik neev ne use aaj tak jeevit (alive) rakha hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The historian Edward Gibbon is associated with the historical study of ..........
questions.explanation: Edward Gibbon ne Roman samrajya ke utthan aur patan ka aitihasik adhyayan likha tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The blind imitation of European civilization would be .......... for India.
questions.explanation: Bhartiya paramparaon ko chhodkar pashchim ki andhi nakal karna desh ke liye aatmaghati (suicidal) sidhh hoga.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From which year to which year did Mahatma Gandhi completely dominate Indian politics?
questions.explanation: Dakshin Africa se laotne ke baad 1915 se 1948 tak Mahatma Gandhi ne Bhartiya swatantrata sangram ka naitratva kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What were the chief weapons successfully used by Mahatma Gandhi against British rule?
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ne Satya aur Ahinsa (Truth and Non-violence) ko apna sabse mukhya hathiyar banakar aazadi dilayi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Mahatma Gandhi born?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi ka janam 2 October 1869 ko Porbandar, Gujarat mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi pass away at the hands of a fanatic?
questions.explanation: 30 January 1948 ko ek kattarpanthi dwara unki hatya kar di gayi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why did our ancestors view large cities as snares and useless encumbrances?

options.B: Because they were full of gangs of thieves, robbers, and vice

questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj mante the ki shahron mein chor, dakait aur ameer logon dwara garibon ka shoshan hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did ordinary people traditionally settle their legal disputes under true Home Rule?

options.A: By hiring expensive lawyers in high courts
options.B: Within the village community without being lured by touts
options.D: By paying bribes to the British officers

questions.explanation: Aam log adalaton aur dalalon ke chakkar mein pade bina gaon ke aapsi bhaichare aur panchayat mein vivad suljha lete the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the primary and honest occupation followed by the vast majority of our ancestors?
questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj mukhya roop se krishi (agriculture) ka vyavasay karte the aur swatantra jeevan jeete the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Mahatma Gandhi, true happiness and contentment primarily come from ..........

options.A: amassing vast amounts of gold and money
options.B: a mental condition of moral restraint and peaceful living

questions.explanation: Gandhi ji spasht karte hain ki sachha sukh manasik santosh aur ichhaon par niyantran se milta hai, dhan se nahi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did our ancestors view professionals like doctors and lawyers?

options.B: As parasites who did not rob people unduly and were dependent on them

questions.explanation: Purvaj mante the ki vakeel aur vaidhya janta ke aashrit hain aur unhe samaj par haavi hone ki anumati nahi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The distinguishing characteristic of modern Western civilization is an indefinite multiplicity of ..........
questions.explanation: Aadhunik sabhyata ki sabse badi pehchan manav ki anant ichhaon (human wants) ko badhate jana hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Civilization, in the real sense of the term, consists in the .......... of wants.
questions.explanation: Vastavik sabhyata ichhaon ko badhane mein nahi, balki unhe swechha se niyantrit (restriction) karne mein hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The primary tendency of Indian civilization is to elevate the ..........
questions.explanation: Bhartiya sabhyata ka mool uddeshya manushya ke naitik astitva (moral being) ko uncha uthana hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The inherent tendency of Western civilization is to privilege ..........
questions.explanation: Pashchimi sabhyata ka mukhy jhukav bhautik sukh-suvidhaon (materiality) ko prathmikta dene mein hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why does Gandhiji call the human mind a 'restless bird'?

options.A: Because it can fly across oceans
options.B: Because the more it gets the more it wants, and still remains unsatisfied

questions.explanation: Man jitni ichhayein poori karta hai utni hi nayi icchaayein janm leti hain aur weh hamesha asantusht rehta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did our ancestors believe regarding mechanical labor vs hand-and-foot labor?

options.A: Manual labor kept the body healthy and morals intact
options.B: Machines should immediately replace all farmers
options.C: Hand work was inferior to factory production

questions.explanation: Hamare purvaj mante the ki haath-paanv se kaam karne se sharir swasth rehta hai aur naitikta bachi rehti hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi's writings and speeches reveal him as a great master of chaste, .......... English.
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ki angrezi bhasha shuddh, spasht aur muhavaredar (idiomatic) thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which two ancient classical civilizations are cited as having lost their former power and glory?
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji pracheen Rome aur Greece ka udaharan dete hain jinki mahan sabhyatayein samay ke sath mit gayi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Nothing can equal the seeds sown by our ancestors' implies that ..........

options.A: Indian crops are the biggest in the world
options.B: the cultural and spiritual foundation laid by our ancestors is unsurpassed
options.C: we should not plant new trees
options.D: ancient seeds never perish in soil

questions.explanation: Iska arth hai ki hamare purvajon dwara sthapit naitik aur aadhyaatmik sanskaron ki tulna koi doosri sabhyata nahi kar sakti.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was Gandhiji's balanced perspective on Western science and discoveries?

options.A: To reject every scientific book from the West
options.B: To assimilate beneficial knowledge while holding fast to our moral roots
options.D: To completely convert India into a Western society

questions.explanation: Gandhi ji pashchimi vigyan se achhi baatein sikhne ke khilaf nahi the, par apni mool sabhyata ko bachaye rakhna chahte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the text, the person who assassinated Mahatma Gandhi is referred to as a ..........
questions.explanation: Pathya-pustak ke parichay mein likha hai ki unka nidhan ek kattarpanthi vyakti (fanatic) ke hathon hua.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In 'Young India', Mahatma Gandhi contributed numerous insightful .......... on diverse national issues.
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ne 'Young India' patrika mein anek prabhavshali lekh aur nibandh likhe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of the word 'Immovable' as applied to Indian civilization?
questions.explanation: 'Immovable' (atal/sthir) ka vipritarthak shabd 'Movable' ya 'Changeable' (chalaayman) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did true 'Home Rule' mean to our ancestors in everyday life?

options.B: Leading an independent, self-disciplined life following honest ancestral vocations
options.C: Building royal palaces in every village

questions.explanation: Hamare purvajon ke liye sachha Home Rule aatm-anushasan, imandari ki kheti aur aatmnirbharta ka jeevan tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the central moral lesson conveyed in 'Indian Civilization and Culture'?

options.A: Industrial growth is the only goal of a nation
options.B: True civilization consists in moral elevation, voluntary restraint, and spiritual faith
options.C: Money and machines are superior to all human virtues
options.D: We must completely abandon all modern communication

questions.explanation: Nibandh ka mool sandesh yahi hai ki vastavik sabhyata naitikta, ichhaon par santosh aur aadhyaatmik vishwas mein nihit hai.
